faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for LIC HFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 November 2026. Applications opened on 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LIC HFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 232 vacancies for Apprentice.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for LIC HFL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scheduled Caste (SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates: Rs.200 plus GST. Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates: Rs.200 plus GST. General, EWS and Other Backward Class (OBC)-Male candidates: Rs.800 plus GST. General, EWS and Other Backward Class (OBC) - Female / Transgender candidates: Rs.600 plus GST.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 20 to 25 years (as on 01-Oct-2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 14,150 to Rs. 16,650 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduation in any stream.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Apprenticeship is NOT an employment and apprentices are NOT employees.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates having a running, terminated, or completed apprenticeship contract with any other organization.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Online Written Examination. Document Verification & Personal Interview. Online remote proctored examination consisting of 100 questions for 100 marks with 60 minutes duration.
